text: {"lessons":["Realized gains on several stocks did not prevent my account value from declining, so I should assess my portfolio’s total risk and prospects rather than equating profitable sales with success.","I held Stock C until selling at a substantial loss; I should reassess a losing position using its current outlook, not my purchase price or reluctance to admit a mistake.","I should resist frequent, price-driven trades like buying and then quickly selling Stock D, and instead make deliberate decisions with clear reasons for buying, holding, or selling."]}
